verdict.rationale: Clerk publishes a migration overview guide and an open-source tool that imports users from a JSON or CSV file through the Backend API while respecting rate limits, so vendor-maintained migration tooling exists. Nothing in the pack says password hashes can be imported to avoid forced resets, and there are no provider-specific guides for moving off a named competitor. Missing for 10: evidence of password-hash import (no forced resets), competitor-specific migration guides (e.g., Auth0/Firebase), independent or hands-on corroboration of migration success.
